--- docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
+++ docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
@@ -142,8 +142,10 @@
 | `GET visitor/{visitorId}` | | The link from the browser's end, if any |
 | `GET shopper/{shopperId}` | | The browsers on the person and the history applied; the account id is not on it |
 | `POST events` | JSON `{ rows }` or `text/csv`, at most 1000 rows | Historical rows into the person's interests: `accountId \| shopperId \| visitorId`, `action`, `at`, and the product attributes the registry reads |
 
+Historical import requires an existing resolved profile with tracking and personalization explicitly stored as `true`; it cannot create a profile or grant consent. Multiple supplied identifiers must resolve to the same subject. Missing state or consent and refused consent are reported by original row index in `skipped`, without changing profile or history counts; corrupt state and failed writes fail the request, which may follow earlier successful rows. Original event times remain subject to erasure cutoffs. This is behavioral history ingestion, not typed external-attribute or precomputed-audience ingestion; consent/identity/erasure operations across stores are not atomic.
+
 ## 4. Content and configuration documents
 
 Four documents per brand, each with the same seven routes. `kind` is `catalog`, `slots`, `learn` or
 `priors`; `scope` is the brand.
